visualCharacteristics.structure: single-slide carousel with prev/next + dot indicators
visualCharacteristics.notes: Block Collection carousel. ~800px wide centered, images at natural ratio (infographics or photos), thin chevron arrows over the slide sides, hollow circle dots (active filled black) over the bottom edge. Image-only slides render without a text overlay. No autoplay.

contentPattern: N rows x 1-2 cells [image | optional text]
